facts.fact: 章首：清晨 Nelveen 绿眼睛近在咫尺——"你睡着时很美"她骂怪胎
facts.anchor: Her eyes fluttered open, only to find Nelveen’s green ones just inches from her face.

facts.fact: 关系确立：她主动"我愿意做你的朋友"——两人正式成为朋友
facts.anchor: “No.” Nelveen’s tone was somber. “I don’t do that to friends. Well, if I had friends, I wouldn’t do that.”

facts.fact: 走廊滑倒被他接住——浴巾 Gerrick+走光睡袍；不欢而散
facts.anchor: Gerrick stood in front of her, naked save for the low hanging towel around his hips.

facts.fact: Levana 衣店：绿血管老妇拥抱 Nelveen"以为你被害了"
facts.anchor: It’s been too long since you stopped in. I was starting to think you had been killed.

facts.fact: Levana 直问"你也是妓女？"——她差点噎住答"只是路过"
facts.anchor: Nearly choking on her words, Andra said, “No ma’am. I’m just passing through.”

facts.fact: 黑裙初见：蕾丝上身+层叠裙——"另一个人生里才配得上"
facts.anchor: She stopped in front of a black dress with a lace bodice and layered skirt.

facts.fact: Levana 哲学：美裙是利器——真正的力量在这里（按胸口）；她内心确认守护而非掌控
facts.anchor: A beautiful dress can be a powerful tool,” Levana mused, placing her palm against her chest.

facts.fact: Nelveen 身世：从孩童起在此做工——Levana 是唯一把她当人而非物件的人
facts.anchor: I’ve been working here a long time. Since I was a child, unfortunately.

facts.fact: 黑裙礼物：Nelveen 买下她恋上的那条——"女人穿美裙不需要理由……今晚可能有个理由"
facts.anchor: “The dress you fell in love with at Levana’s shop?” Nelveen laid the dress on the bed. “Yes, it is.”

facts.fact: Rayner 送包裹+额外一个——Nelveen 身姿一僵意外道谢
facts.anchor: “Relax, Nelveen. It’s right here. Oh, and I picked this one up for you.”

facts.fact: 章末悬念：黑色蕾丝面具（翼尖上翘）——"他会解释的"；Nelveen 收起自己的红面具
facts.anchor: In her lap sat a black mask, wide enough to cover her eyes, with upward slanting wing tips on the sides.
